text: A viral document falsely presented as a Bahria University Islamabad Academics Branch notice claimed that male and female students standing together as a couple on campus during Ramadan would be made to enter into a nikkah immediately. The purported circular, dated 20 February 2026, also claimed that the students would be responsible for arranging their own walima. This is a false claim, not a Bahria University policy or announcement. Bahria University publicly denied issuing the document, and fact-checkers reported that the circular was fabricated and falsely attributed to the university.
source: Original claim: X post by @abrawkadabraw; verification: Soch Fact Check, Geo Fact-Check, and Bahria University public clarification
verification_note: FAKE: Soch Fact Check records the purported claim and reports Bahria University's explicit denial via its verified Instagram account.
